EC1: Patients who have Tacrolimus trough level resulted as 2 ng/mg at the baseline.
EC2: Patients who are on steroid therapy due to positive result of acute rejection test before the baseline.
EC3: Patients who have received a transplant besides liver.
EC4: Patients who are allergic to IP or [OR] macrolide compounds.
EC5: Patients who are on cyclosporine, bo [OR]sentan, or [OR] potassium sparing diuretic.
EC6: Patients with genetic diseases such as galactose intolerance, Lap [OR]p lactase deficiency, or  [OR]glucose-galactose malabsorption.
EC8: Patients not willing to adhere to study procedures/treatments.
